interface.name: list_coupons
interface.title: List Store Coupons
interface.description: Returns a paginated list of the store's discount coupons, each with its code, discount type and amount, validity window, free-shipping flag, usage limits and usage statistics, optionally narrowed by a keyword or by a creation or expiry date range.
whenToUse: The merchant wants to see the coupons their store has, e.g. 'what discount codes do I have?' or 'list my coupons'.
The merchant asks whether a particular code exists or what it gives, e.g. 'do I still have DEAL10?' -- filter with the keyword argument.
The merchant asks which coupons are about to expire or already have, e.g. 'which codes expire this month?' -- filter with expiresBetween and read expiry_date.
The merchant asks what they created in a period, e.g. 'the coupons I made in Ramadan' -- filter with createdBetween.
The merchant wants to know how much a coupon is being used, e.g. 'is anyone actually using my codes?' -- read the statistics field on each coupon.
An agent needs coupon ids or codes before reporting on, updating or deleting a specific coupon.
whenNotToUse: The merchant named ONE specific coupon and wants its full record -- use get_coupon with the coupon id instead.
The merchant wants the individual generated codes that sit under a group coupon rather than the coupons themselves -- use list_coupon_codes instead.
The merchant wants to create, edit or delete a coupon -- this tool only reads; use create_coupon, update_coupon or delete_coupon instead.
The merchant is asking about automatic discounts that apply without a code, such as buy-one-get-one or bundle promotions -- use list_special_offers instead.
The merchant is asking about affiliate or marketer commission records rather than the coupons themselves -- use list_affiliates instead.

page.description: Pagination page number. The response returns one page of coupons; increment to fetch the rest.

keyword.description: Filter coupons to those matching this keyword, e.g. part of a coupon code or a group name.

createdBetween.description: Return only coupons CREATED inside this date range, given as exactly two YYYY-MM-DD dates, earliest first: ['2026-01-01', '2026-03-31']. Salla takes the range as a pair, so both ends are required -- for an open end, use a far date rather than omitting one.

expiresBetween.description: Return only coupons whose EXPIRY date falls inside this range, given as exactly two YYYY-MM-DD dates, earliest first: ['2026-01-01', '2026-03-31']. This is the filter for 'what is expiring soon' and 'what has already lapsed'; it says nothing about when the coupon was created.

id.description: The coupon id, used by sibling coupon tools.

code.description: The code a customer types at checkout, e.g. 'DEAL10'. Quote this one back to a merchant, not the id.

type.description: How the discount is calculated: 'fixed' for a flat amount off, 'percentage' for a share of the cart.

status.description: Whether the coupon is currently usable, e.g. 'active' or 'inactive'. A coupon can be active and still be past its expiry_date, so check both before telling a merchant a code works.

amount.description: The discount the coupon gives. For a percentage coupon the amount is the percentage, not money.

minimum_amount.description: The cart total a customer must reach before the coupon applies; null when there is no minimum. Salla returns this either as a bare number or as a {amount, currency} object depending on how the coupon was created, so read both shapes.

start_date.description: When the coupon becomes usable, e.g. '2026-03-17 00:00:00'; null when it is usable immediately.

expiry_date.description: When the coupon stops working, e.g. '2026-03-17 00:00:00', in the store's timezone.

free_shipping.description: True when the coupon also waives the shipping cost.

usage_limit.description: How many times the coupon may be redeemed in total across the store; null when unlimited.

usage_limit_per_user.description: How many times a single customer may redeem it; null when unlimited.

statistics.description: How the coupon has performed so far.

num_of_usage.description: How many times the coupon has been redeemed.

num_of_customers.description: How many distinct customers have redeemed it.

coupon_sales.description: The sales value of the orders the coupon was used on -- {amount, currency}.

amount.description: Total sales attributed to the coupon.

http.summary: List Coupons -- return a list of the store's coupons, filterable by a keyword and by a creation or expiration date range.

query.name: keyword
query.description: A keyword matched against the coupon code and group name.

query.name: creation_date
query.description: Creation date range, taken by Salla as an array of two YYYY-MM-DD dates and serialized Laravel-style as creation_date[]=2026-01-01&creation_date[]=2026-03-31.

query.name: expiration_date
query.description: Expiry date range, taken by Salla as an array of two YYYY-MM-DD dates and serialized Laravel-style as expiration_date[]=2026-01-01&expiration_date[]=2026-03-31.

statuses.meaning: The store's access token is missing, expired, or does not carry the marketing.read scope, so the store's coupons cannot be read until the app's authorization is fixed.

rules.message: keyword must contain at least one non-whitespace character; omit it entirely to list every coupon
